parsed_response.explanation: The agents exhibit inconsistent reasoning regarding the innervation of the soft palate muscles. While some agents correctly identify the vagus and trigeminal nerves, others incorrectly suggest the glossopharyngeal nerve, leading to conflicting answers even after reviewing other agents' opinions.
parsed_response.evidence: Assistant1 in step 2 and 4 consistently chooses (J) trigeminal and vagus nerves. Assistant2 in step 8 changes its answer from (J) to (H) glossopharyngeal and vagus nerves, stating 'the trigeminal nerve (CN V) primarily provides sensory innervation rather than motor control to the soft palate muscles.' Assistant3 in step 10 chooses (H) and then in step 12 changes to (J), acknowledging the trigeminal nerve's role for the tensor veli palatini. This shows inconsistent reasoning across agents and within the same agent.
